facts.text: Evan had a pee accident near some roses and felt embarrassed about it.

evidence.quote: Oof, Sam, so embarrassing! I had a pee accident near some roses - can you believe it? I'm so sorry about that.

facts.text: Evan apologized for the accident and was fortunate that the people involved were understanding.

evidence.quote: I was so embarrassed when I saw what happened the next morning, so I apologized and luckily they were understanding.
They were understanding, which was great.

facts.text: Evan and his partner tried snowshoeing over the weekend as part of a new adventure.

evidence.quote: my partner and I tried snowshoeing this weekend. It was part of a new adventure for us and surprisingly fun.

facts.text: Sam made a meal plan and workout schedule and is committed to staying on track with his health goals.

evidence.quote: I made a meal plan and workout schedule. I'm getting motivated by something I saw, so starting today I'm gonna do my best to stay on track.
